title: Resveratrol triggers autophagy-related apoptosis to inhibit the progression of colorectal cancer via inhibition of FOXQ1.
authors: Zhou, MinFeng; Niu, HuiFang; Cui, DanDan; Huang, GuoQuan; Li, JinXiao; Tian, HaoRan; Xu, XiaoJuan; Liang, FengXia; Chen, Rui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇通过SIRT1/FOXQ1/ATG16L通路抑制结直肠癌，虽涉及FOXQ1转录因子和分子对接，但核心是肿瘤治疗机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅浅层使用。
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a significant health problem with elevated mortality rates, prompting intense exploration of its complex molecular mechanisms and innovative therapeutic avenues. Resveratrol (RSV), recognised for its anticancer effects through SIRT1 activation, is a promising candidate for CRC treatment. This study focuses on elucidating RSV's role in CRC progression, particularly its effect on autophagy-related apoptosis. Using bioinformatics, protein imprinting and immunohistochemistry, we established a direct correlation between FOXQ1 and adverse CRC prognosis. Comprehensive in vitro experiments confirmed RSV's ability to promote autophagy-related apoptosis in CRC cells. Plasmids for SIRT1 modulation were used to investigate underlying mechanisms. Molecular docking, glutathione-S-transferase pull-down experiments and immunoprecipitation highlighted RSV's direct activation of SIRT1, resulting in the inhibition of FOXQ1 expression. Downstream interventions identified ATG16L as a crucial autophagic target. In vivo and in vitro studies validated RSV's potential for CRC therapy through the SIRT1/FOXQ1/ATG16L pathway. This study establishes RSV's capacity to enhance autophagy-related cell apoptosis in CRC, positioning RSV as a prospective therapeutic agent for CRC within the SIRT1/FOXQ1/ATG16L pathway.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）是一个具有高死亡率的重大健康问题，促使其复杂分子机制和创新治疗途径的深入探索。白藜芦醇（RSV）因其通过SIRT1激活发挥抗癌作用而闻名，是CRC治疗的有前景候选药物。本研究聚焦于阐明RSV在CRC进展中的作用，特别是其对自噬相关凋亡的影响。利用生物信息学、蛋白质印迹和免疫组织化学，我们建立了FOXQ1与CRC不良预后之间的直接相关性。全面的体外实验证实了RSV促进CRC细胞自噬相关凋亡的能力。使用用于SIRT1调控的质粒来研究潜在机制。分子对接、谷胱甘肽S-转移酶pull-down实验和免疫沉淀突出了RSV对SIRT1的直接激活，从而导致FOXQ1表达的抑制。下游干预确定了ATG16L为关键的自噬靶点。体内和体外研究验证了RSV通过SIRT1/FOXQ1/ATG16L通路治疗CRC的潜力。本研究确立了RSV增强CRC中自噬相关细胞凋亡的能力，将RSV定位为SIRT1/FOXQ1/ATG16L通路中CRC的前瞻性治疗药物。
